evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Amy: 'My name is Amy' and later 'Thank you Barry. I hope you have a great weekend.' — name asked at open and used at close.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Amy: 'This call will probably take five to ten minutes. Does that sound good?' — time-boxed but no promise of a dependable quote, and no clear wait for yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Amy: 'Maybe they're worried that the movers won't show up on time or that an item will get damaged. What about you would either of those concern you or do you have any specific concerns that I should alert the movers with anything at all.' — asked before probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Barry raises two concerns (on-time delivery contingent on dates, TVs needing protection). Amy acknowledges both ('Okay', 'Right', 'Got it') but does not probe deeper with 'tell me more' or silence — she pivots immediately to packing.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Amy says 'Got it' and moves on without reflecting back what she heard.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned. Amy says 'no additional fees' but does not frame the two core promises.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Amy opens with concerns question, but logistics are incomplete. Addresses and property type confirmed, floor/stories confirmed (one story), rooms mentioned (3 bedrooms), but no explicit probing for special considerations (the TVs came up, but not as a structured concern-led probe), walking distances not asked, additional rooms/garage/shed not asked.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Packing asked ('do you need help packing your boxes or would you have those ready to go'). Box count never asked — Amy mentions 'usually house the size 2800 or let's say 3000 square foot home' but does not ask if customer has anything that might put them over typical.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: N/A — walkthrough scheduled, not booked on this call.

top_strength: Amy successfully identified that this was a walkthrough-scheduler call (3000 sq ft, out-of-town, two-day move requiring site assessment) and cleanly routed to scheduling instead of forcing an incomplete quote.
coaching_note: When the customer raises a concern, pause and dig in with at least one follow-up question (like 'tell me more about that') before pivoting — especially on TVs, which is a real damage risk; this shows you heard and care, not just that you acknowledge and move on.
